notes.title: [Resolved] Fix for Error When Loading Game
notes.notes:

Valve has applied a patch that should correct this issue.
(See: https://steamcommunity.com/groups/SteamClientBeta/discussions/0/3805027864671264896/?tscn=1689035343)
Thank you Valve for your quick response!

notes.title: Two releases - Muv-Luv Unlimited : The Day After and Muv-Luv Alternative Manga!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32208705/7c875460e5be54041093236bab311a0b50b2a485.jpg[/img]

We at aNCHOR are proud to announce the official release of our newest localized title, Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After! All 4 episodes will be available on Steam starting today - February 5th, 2021!

[previewyoutube=wKkvbuLhEns;full][/previewyoutube]

Picking up directly where Muv-Luv Unlimited left off, witness the aftermath of Alternative V, as the last remnants of humanity fight a desperate battle for survival on a barren and desolate Earth! notes.title: Photons side stories status, SGM online, and MLA Director's Cut patch update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

The translation team is currently working on [b]photonmelodies[/b], as they've recently finished the localization of [b]photonflowers[/b]! We're now at the programming and debugging phase, so keep your eyes peeled for updates in the coming months!

If you want to know more about the contents of photonflowers and photonmelodies, please visit our forum page here: [url]https://community.muvluv.moe/index.php?/topic/144-what-are-photonflowers-and-photonmelodies-do-they-include-muv-luv-altered-fable/[/url]

[h1]Sekai Project's SGM is online![/h1]
 
[url]https://sgm.sekaiproject.com[/url]

"Steam Game Manager" or "SGM" is an awesome system created by Sekai Project to help give bonus game keys/dlcs to owners of an existing game.

If you own the original AppID of Muv-Luv and/or Muv-Luv Alternative, and want to get the new AppID(s), just simply follow the steps below:
1. Set your "Game Details" to public (under Edit Profile → Privacy Settings) [i]You can set it back to private after receiving the key(s)[/i]
2. Login to SGM using your Steam account.
3  Set a valid e-mail, then confirm it by clicking the link in your e-mail.
4. Click the "Request Key" button(s).

After that, you just need to wait for a few hours then you'll be notified of the new key(s) assigned to your account via e-mail. 

SGM is still a BETA product, so please let us know if you encountered any issues.

[i]Note: We can no longer generate keys for the old AppID.[/i]

[h1]Muv-Luv Alternative Director's Cut Patch is underway![/h1]

Last but not the least, we're quite happy to say we've started working on the Director's Cut patch of Muv-Luv Alternative. Thanks again to everyone who supported us in making this happen. Rest assured we'll keep you updated of the development progress of the patch and photonflowers.

Cheers,

The Muv-Luv Team

notes.title: Original AppID owners can now get their live version copies!
notes.notes:
Greetings and salutations everyone,

Our trusted comrades at Sekai Project have begun working on the third party solution using Steam API, to help distribute the live version Steam keys to the original AppID owners. It may take around the 4th week of April for them to complete it.

However, as the announcement title says, the original owners can already get their live version Steam key(s)!

1. Just simply send us an e-mail at [b][u]tanaka@ixtl.jp[/u][/b] with the following details:
a. link to your Steam user account.
b. (optional) if you have reviewed the game(s), send us a link to the review(s).

2. Add http://steamcommunity.com/id/tanaka_muvluv/ as a friend

3. Once the friend request has been approved, send them a private message containing your email address.

It'll take around 1-7 business days for us to send the key, depending on the amount of requests.

Cheers,

Marimo@The Muv-Luv Team
